How it works

From blank page to paid invoice

A clear path freelancers and agencies already follow inside CraftDocs.

01

Pick a document type

Invoice, GST tax invoice, quotation, PO, challan, receipt — twenty formats ready for Indian and global billing.

02

Choose a template & brand

Apply your logo, colors, stamp, and signature. Switch paper size, orientation, and layout in the design panel.

03

Add clients, items & tax

Pull from your catalogs. CraftDocs calculates totals, discounts, and GST splits automatically.

04

Export, share & get paid

Download PDF, share a public link, remind over WhatsApp, and collect via UPI QR on the share page.
